title: Strategic Buyer - Large Power Transformers
description:

You will support the development of commodity strategies for our greenfield power transformer factory, lead sourcing initiatives to drive Total Cost Reduction, and help ensure a resilient and reliable supply chain. * Develops and drives the implementation of material strategies for key materials, including copper, surge arresters, connectors, cooling systems, and fiberglass. DataOne designs, develops, and operates sustainable AI Factories, bringing together energy, infrastructure, and artificial intelligence at industrial scale.
